name: vertical-kern-text
title: Vertical Kern Text
description: A label set in vertical writing mode with upright Latin glyphs and controlled letter spacing, for spines, rails and side navigation where horizontal space is the constraint.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Industrial
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Condensed
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
